## Checks

- [ ] One concern in this pull request. A key rotation and a UI change are two.
- [ ] Nothing here sends, injects or modifies anything on the wire, and nothing
      automates play.
- [ ] No other player's name or chat text appears in any fixture, log, screenshot
      or test added here.
- [ ] No `.env`, database dump, `backups/`, or anything copied out of the game
      install is committed.
- [ ] New test fixtures are **real captured bytes**, kept byte-exact — not
      hand-constructed. (Hand-written fixtures have been added here twice; they
      prove the parser agrees with your idea of the protocol, not with the
      protocol.)
- [ ] Wire data is `Option`/`Result` with a fallback — no `unwrap()` on anything
      that came off the network.
- [ ] Message keys are referred to by semantic name, not by wire token. Field
      numbers are in `sniffer/schema.json`, not in Rust.
